name: Cleverhood
old_description: I tour for a living, and I can’t stress how nice it is when it rains to be able to pull this out of my production case not only to stay dry but it looks great. The cuts and style are very unique constantly have co workers asking where I got it. Fits true to size and the front pocket is so great for keeping your phone or wallet dry. So pleased this this product will be ordering more.
about:
Cleverhood operates from Providence, Rhode Island, where it designs and manufactures a line of technical rainwear. The company runs its own garment production and sells directly through an online shop built on Shopify, serving customers across a long list of international markets.

The product range centers on fully waterproof outerwear built for active use: the Rover Anorak and Rover Rain Cape for cyclists, the Urbanaut Trench for urban wear, plus accessories such as Zipsters and hats. Production covers cut-and-sew assembly of waterproof fabrics, with design details like thumb loops for handlebar grip and a belt accessory to keep the cape in place while riding.

The brand targets cyclists, urban commuters, and outdoor enthusiasts who need reliable rain protection without sacrificing appearance. WIRED magazine named one of its jackets the "Best Rain Jacket For Cycling," and customer testimonials cite touring musicians, daily bike commuters, and dog walkers who value the combination of coverage, pocket placement, and tailored fit.

Cleverhood positions its gear at the intersection of form and function, promoting the idea that there is "No Such Thing as Bad Weather" when the right outerwear is at hand. The company was founded to solve the gap between technical waterproofing and everyday style, delivering garments that look at home on a city street as on a bike trail.
